snippets: Meet the K1, the compact humanoid robot from Booster Robotics, built to make advanced robotics and embodied AI accessible and mobile. Standing under one meter and weighing just 19.5 kg, the K1 delivers impressive mobility, perception and onboard computing power in a form that can travel easily between labs, classrooms

K1 comes equipped with a versatile sensor suite enabling multimodal interaction and perception: • RGB-D (depth) camera: allows depth perception and 3D vision — useful for navigation, object detection, obstacle avoidance, environment understanding. • 9-axis IMU (Inertial Measurement Unit): for balance control, motion sensing, pose estimation, necessary for stable walking and reacting to disturbances.

Powered by an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX offering up to 117 TOPS, the K1 can run real-time vision, navigation and AI inference without relying on external compute. Its RGB-D camera and 9-axis IMU give it spatial awareness and balance, while built-in microphones and a speaker support natural interaction.
